title: Uniqueness of the halting step
statement: Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine and let $x$ be an input word. If $M$ halts at step $t_1$ on $x$ and also halts at step $t_2$ on $x$, then $t_1=t_2$.
hypotheses_covered: The halting-at-step predicate holds at $t_1$ for the given machine and input
The halting-at-step predicate holds at $t_2$ for the same machine and input
replaced:
Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine and fix an input word.  If $M$ halts on
that input after exactly $t_1$ steps and also after exactly $t_2$ steps, then
$t_1 = t_2$.
